properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-073 Communication observed with IOC tracked in watchlist
properties.query:
let TriggeredUsers =  SecurityAlert
    | where DisplayName == "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-073 Communication observed with IOC tracked in watchlist"
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago (5h)
    | extend A = parse_json(Entities)
    | mvexpand A
    | extend IPAddress = A.Address
    | where isnotempty(IPAddress)
    | distinct tostring(IPAddress);
let lookup_time=10m;
let watchlist_ip = watchlist_IP_IOC
    | union watchlist_ip_IOC_QBOT;
let watchlist_domain = watchlist_domain_IOC
    | union watchlist_domain_IOC_QBOT;
let watchlist_hash = watchlist_hash_IOC 
    | union watchlist_hash_IOC_QBOT;
let listofips = watchlist_ip 
    | project ioc_ip;
let listofdomains = watchlist_domain
    | project ioc_domain;
let listofhashes = watchlist_hash
    | project ioc_Hash;
let dns1 = DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookup_time)
    | where Name has_any (listofdomains) 
    | project-rename DestinationHostName=Name, SourceIP=ClientIP
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredUsers)
    | extend logcategory="dns";
let ceflogs_ip = CommonSecurityLog1  
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookup_time)
    | where DestinationIP has_any (listofips)
    | extend logcategory ="network"
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredUsers);
let pasyslog_ip = paloaltologs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookup_time)
    | where DestinationIP has_any (listofips)
    | where Activity == "TRAFFIC"
    | extend logcategory ="network"
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredUsers);
let ceflogs_domain = CommonSecurityLog1  
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookup_time)
    | where DestinationHostName has_any (listofdomains) 
    | extend logcategory ="network"
    | where DestinationHostName != "ineportalapi-weu-prd.securitycenter.windows.com"
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredUsers);
let pasyslog_domain = paloaltologs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookup_time)
    | where ThreatType == "url"
    | where DestinationHostName has_any (listofdomains) 
    | where SyslogMessage !has ",CONFIG,"
    | where DestinationHostName != "ineportalapi-weu-prd.securitycenter.windows.com"
    | extend logcategory ="network"
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredUsers);
let bclogs_domain = bluecoat
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookup_time)
    | where DestinationHostName has_any (listofdomains)
    | where DestinationHostName != "ineportalapi-weu-prd.securitycenter.windows.com"
    | extend logcategory ="network"
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredUsers);
let sepmlogs_hash=symantec
    | where FileHash in (listofhashes) 
    | extend logcategory ="av"
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredUsers);
(union
    ceflogs_ip,
    pasyslog_ip,
    ceflogs_domain,
    pasyslog_domain,
    bclogs_domain,
    dns1,
    sepmlogs_hash) 
| join kind=leftouter watchlist_ip on $left.DestinationIP == $right.ioc_ip
| join kind=leftouter watchlist_domain on $left.DestinationHostName == $right.ioc_domain 
| where not (logcategory == "dns" and DestinationHostName has_any (watchlist_domain_IOC_QBOT))
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend HostCustomEntity = HostName
